title: Assistant Professor of Management Science, Tenure-Track, Fall 2027
description:
Description

George L. Argyros College of Business and Economics at Chapman
University in Orange, California invites applications for a
tenure-track Assistant Professor position in Management Science
beginning August 1, 2027.

The position provides a competitive salary and ample support for
teaching and research including a reduced teaching load, a summer
research stipend, and a discretionary research budget.

Chapman University is a nationally-ranked, R2 Carnegie Classified,
private institution offering traditional undergraduate and graduate
programs in the heart of Orange County, one of Southern
California's most diverse and vibrant regions. Chapman's campuses
are home to nearly 10,000 students representing 50 states, four
territories, and 76 countries. The 11 schools and colleges of
Chapman, including Argryos College of Business and Economics, offer
50 bachelors, 29 master, and 8 doctoral programs, along with nearly
75 minors and 19 accelerated and bridge programs. Classes are
taught by the more than 1,100 dedicated faculty members who are
leaders in their fields, including Nobel Prize recipients,
MacArthur Fellows, National Medal of Science honorees, former U.S
Supreme Court clerks, and Emmy, Grammy, and Academy Award
winners.

The Argyros College of Business and Economics (ACBE) is fully
accredited by AACSB and offers a variety of undergraduate and
graduate programs, including an MS in Business Analytics degree.
Chapman's full-time MBA program is ranked #53 nationally by US News
and World Report. The school currently has 1,800 undergraduates and
150 graduate students who attend classes in a modern 100,000 square
foot state-of-the-art facility. Chapman is also home to the
world-renowned Economic Sciences Institute, headed by Nobel
Laureate Vernon Smith. Additional information can be found at
http://www.chapman.edu/business .

Responsibilities

Engage in scholarly research, leading to publications in
high-quality journals.
Teach a range of courses that reflect the specialty interests
of the candidate and the needs of the school.
Serve on academic committees or task forces within the
institution
Tenure track faculty are expected to develop and maintain an
active research agenda for future tenure consideration and are
evaluated on their scholarship, teaching and service.

Qualifications

We invite applicants with academic training in Information Systems,
Operations Management, Data Analytics, Industrial and Systems
Engineering, the Economics of Digitization, or related fields. We
are particularly interested in candidates whose research interests
relate to AI and healthcare, though highly qualified candidates
with other areas of research are still encouraged to apply. This
position is open to either advanced junior professors or PhD
candidates who will have their PhDs conferred before the start
date.

Requirements include:

A Ph.D. in Information Systems, Operations Management,
Economics, Industrial and Systems Engineering, or other data
science-related discipline from an accredited institution is
required.
Demonstrated potential for publishing high-quality academic
research. Applicants with several or more years of experience
beyond the doctoral degree should have a record of high-quality
publications.
Evidence of teaching effectiveness.

Application Instructions

Qualified candidates should submit:

1. Letter of application

2. Curriculum Vitae

3. Contact Information for at least three references

4. Research statement

5. Examples of recent scholarly work

6. Evidence of teaching effectiveness if available

Inquiries can be directed to the Search Committee Chair, Dylan
Walker, dylan@chapman.edu .
Please use "2027 Management Science Position" as the email subject
line.

Evaluation of applicants will begin upon receipt of applications
and will continue on a rolling basis until the position is filled.
The salary range for this position is $175,000 to $200,000 and will
be commensurate with experience. This position is contingent on
final budget approval. Successful completion of a background check
is required for the final candidate.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Chapman University is an equal opportunity employer that provides
equal employment opportunities to all individuals, regardless of
their protected characteristics. All qualified applicants and
employees are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration
for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex,
sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national
origin, ancestry, citizenship status, physical disability, mental
disability, medical condition, military and veteran status, marital
status, pregnancy, genetic information or any other characteristic
protected by state or federal law.
